title: Lesson
description:
One lesson after parsing one line of scripture (characters/<id>/scripture.md or temple/scripture.md). Scripture stays Markdown that the owner edits directly; each lesson is one line with a fixed grammar:

  - [L_<yyyymmdd>_<6 base32>] <one imperative sentence> <!-- verdict=<quest>-<n> hit=<yyyy-mm-dd> retired=<yyyy-mm-dd> -->

The comment and its keys are optional. A line the owner adds without id or comment gets an id from the parser and source = user; it needs no verdict. Lessons written by the Monk always point to the verdict they come from. `elvaria scripture lint` reports lines that break the grammar; the parser is tolerant.
$comment: Hand-written v1, the reviewed target; from P0-03 generated by `pnpm schemas` from zod (ADR 0003). created_at is the date encoded in the id; last_hit_at and retired_at come from the comment keys hit= and retired=, so all three are dates, not date-times. Personal scripture is capped at 40 lines; a lesson not hit for 3 seasons is retired; a lesson found in 2 or more characters moves to the temple.

version.description: Set by the parser; the Markdown line itself carries no version.

owner.description: A character slug, or `temple` for the shared scripture.

source_verdict.description: Verdict the lesson comes from; required when source = monk.

examples.text: Run `pnpm i18n:check` before submitting any locale change.
Never read .env or infra/secrets; ask for the secret by name.
